newsitem.title: USA: Brandywine Realty shares being offered.
newsitem.headline: Brandywine Realty shares being offered.

text.p: Brandywine Realty Trust said Thursday it priced an offering of 2.2 million common shares at $20-5/8 per share.
Smith Barney Inc and Legg Mason Wood Walker Inc are underwriters for the offering, which is expected to close on March 4, the company said.
Brandywine also said it has granted to the underwriters an option, exercisable for a 30 day period, to purchase up to 330,000 shares to cover overallotments.

The company said it plans to use its proceeds primarily to fund the acquisition of 10 properties containing an aggregate of 400,000 square feet for a purchase price of $28.6 million and to repay advances under the company's revolving line of credit.

Following completion of the offering, it is expected that the company will own 52 commercial and industrial properties containing 2.7 million net rentable square feet, the company said. It expects to continue the strategy of making opportunistic acquisitions of office and industrial properties in suburban Philadelphia.
